what: A small photo inside the panel (.65x) grows on scroll until it covers the panel. The same photo is layered behind it: the second layer grows to 1.5x at first, the first layer to 1.25x with a .1 delay, and the front photo to 1x with a .2 delay, giving a sense of depth like stepping into a room. Each layer uses power2.out, with scrub .8 from when the section’s top edge passes 50% up the screen until its bottom edge reaches the bottom of the screen. Attached text (numbers, figures) appears for a .5 share starting at the 1/3 point.

options.step: Extra amount per layer, default .25 (first layer 1.25 · second 1.5)
options.lead: Share of the timeline (out of 3) where the back layer starts first, default .1
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Clipping panel for the layers (overflow hidden if used)
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Same photo layered behind — in order starting from the nearest in front
options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: Text shown while growing (number · value · button)

from.where: index.html .st-apart (a small project photo inside the green panel fills the screen — from panel to room)

note: Layers are placed in the DOM with the back layer first (so the front photo is drawn on top). The section height is set by the user (the original is a fixed board + about 300vh)
